name: aarch64-unknown-linux-ohos-pkg-config
description: 针对OpenHarmony系统的aarch64架构pkg-config工具，用于检索已安装库的编译和链接信息。

options.description: Show help options
output version of pkg-config
output version for package
require given version of pkg-config
output all linker flags
output linker flags for static linking
print short errors
output -l flags
output other libs (e.g. -pthread)
output -L flags
output all pre-processor and compiler flags
output -I flags
output cflags not covered by the cflags-only-I option
get the value of variable named NAME
set variable NAME to VALUE
return 0 if the module(s) exist
output list of variables defined by the module
return 0 if the uninstalled version of one or more module(s) or their dependencies will be used
return 0 if the module is at least version VERSION
return 0 if the module is at exactly version VERSION
return 0 if the module is at no newer than version VERSION
list all known packages
show verbose debug information
show verbose information about missing or conflicting packages (default unless --exists or --atleast/exact/max-version given on the command line)
be silent about errors (default when --exists or --atleast/exact/max-version given on the command line)
print errors from --print-errors to stdout not stderr
print which packages the package provides
print which packages the package requires
print which packages the package requires for static linking
validate a package's .pc file
try to override the value of prefix for each .pc file found with a guesstimated value based on the location of the .pc file
don't try to override the value of prefix for each .pc file found with a guesstimated value based on the location of the .pc file
set the name of the variable that pkg-config automatically sets
